subject: Leadership alignment + procurement path — summary & open risks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@healthsync.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Leadership alignment + procurement path — summary & open risks

Elena — thanks again for the time today. Short recap from our side + suggested next steps so we all have the same expectations going into procurement and the executive review.

Quick TL;DR
- Primary business outcomes you reiterated: 1) Improve claim adjudication throughput by 3x during peak windows, 2) reduce manual triage volume by ~40% within 90 days of pilot, 3) keep PII out of third-party logs.
- Top risk areas we flagged: data residency & audit logs, SSO / IdP integration, and SLA for 95th percentile latency on 10k QPS burst patterns.
- Proposed inaugural engagement: 8-week pilot with a scoped dataset, a dedicated redwood-dedicated pool (reserved capacity), and a go/no-go checkpoint at week 6.

Action items (owner / timing):
1) HealthSync: share the procurement contact + vendor evaluation form (requested) — Elena / by 5/5
2) Redwood: send pilot SOW draft and cost estimate; include optional quantization profile and canary model variant — Marissa / today (attached)
3) Tech deep-dive: Rishi to do an architecture note on SSO, VPC peering options, and audit log formats — Rishi / by 5/7
4) Exec one-pager: Marissa to produce a 1-page benefits & risks summary for HealthSync leadership — Marissa / by 5/6

Open questions we need to confirm before SOW:
- Does procurement require an initial PO or will they accept a standard SOW + Net30?
- Any minimum certification or security evidence beyond SOC2 (e.g., shared penetration test report, encryption at rest keys required)?

Attachments: pilot-statement-of-work-draft.pdf (draft), cost-estimate-q2.xlsx (sizing + price bands).

If this looks right I will: 1) send a formal SOW + DocuSign link, 2) open a HubSpot task for the procurement timeline, and 3) schedule a 30-minute technical touchpoint with Rishi.

Thanks — Marissa

--

Date: 2027-05-03T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership alignment + procurement path — summary & open risks

Marissa — this is very helpful, thank you. Confirming a few quick points:

- Procurement prefers a SOW + pricing worksheet and then a PO. Net30 is standard but they will need the SOW to start internal review.
- I attached our vendor evaluation template. Can you fill the security section or point me to the right contact?
- We will need KMS details (customer-managed keys preferred) and a pointer to your SOC2 report. Those are the two gating items for legal.

I'll loop procurement explicitly on this thread so they have the background. Will also share an approximate timeline for our leadership review by EOD 5/4.

Best,
Elena

Attached: vendor-eval-form.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T14:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership alignment + procurement path — tech checks & risk notes

Marissa / Grace — quick internal note to seed the tech artifact I will share:

- Data residency: we can offer a VPC-private deployment in us-central1 that keeps logs inside HealthSync's VPC. Need to confirm whether HealthSync requires a dedicated control plane (they said "private deployment" as an option in the call).
- Audit logs: provide structured JSON logs with per-request request_id, model_version, and redacted prompt/response by default. We can provide a streaming audit log to their Splunk/CloudWatch endpoint.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS or external HSM; need the KMS key ARN or vendor guidelines.
- SLA/latency: for the pilot sizing (targeting 10k peak qps bursts), recommend dedicated pool with autoscale floor + a canary smaller-parameter model for high-concurrency tails.

I'll produce a one-page tech appendix (SSO, VPC peering options, log format examples) by 5/7 and drop into the shared HubSpot record.

— Rishi
Technical Lead, Production Inference
